decisions.reason: Having survived the first review, this close-to-core plugin likely meets at least a minimal aspiration level, but its modest strategic distinctiveness and low later visibility make it a plausible candidate for pruning if attention or resources tighten.

The ERP interface plugin strongly supports the firm's end-to-end ecommerce and multichannel positioning, so boundedly rational management would usually retain it unless results were clearly below aspiration.

After the earlier withdrawal of similar price-comparison plugins, the remaining tracking plugin is probably the strongest option in that niche, though higher aspirations in a growing market still leave some risk of discontinuation.

This reporting plugin remains close to the firm's analytics and optimization capabilities and can be carried with existing know-how, but it would be vulnerable if its niche demand no longer justifies continued maintenance versus new development.
